recording.riwaya: Hafs an Asim, by inference only: EveryAyah lists the set without a riwaya prefix (its non-Hafs sets are prefixed, e.g. "(Warsh)"; recitations_ayat.html, 2026-10-23), and the folder has exactly the 6,236 files of the Kufan count. Not confirmed by ear.

rights.evidence: EveryAyah publishes no licence or terms for its audio (checked 2026-10-23). The files' ID3 album tag reads "(C) VerseByVerseQuran.Com" (9 files) and their artist tag "Muhammad Jibreel"; 8:73 was replaced by a file tagged "everyayah.com". No permission for use in an app is recorded: development preview only.

rule: unified per-ayah severity (per-ayah/severity.mjs): Very High only on corroborated evidence of a serious recitation problem; files that cannot be assessed are exceptions; weak or uncertain evidence alone is high / medium / check. Low is never a verification.

durationBins.method: rolling window of the 300 ayahs nearest in letter count, surah pace removed, z by the window MAD (floor 0.03 log)
